text: Ah I'm sorry now to be ringing about this at this hour. I've my granddaughter here, she's 3 months, and she won't settle at all tonight, though otherwise she seems grand in herself I think. Temp is 37.8. She has a few insect bites on her legs that seem to be itchy on her, she's rubbing at them. Her neck seems fine, she can bend her head down to look at her tummy. Her mouth gave me a fright for a second, gone all purple around the lips, but then I realised it's the blackcurrant juice off my own cup that she got at, it comes away on a wet cloth. I'm probably fussing over nothing, sorry.
